tagline.zh: 行高 × 字号 = 基线倍数:先按密度算 lh = fs×m,再吸附到基线半格 lh = round(fs×m/unit)×unit——乘法管张力、加法管秩序,中西文各有硬约束。
tagline.en: Line-height × font-size = baseline multiples: compute density first (lh = fs×m), then snap to the grid half-step (lh = round(fs×m/unit)×unit) — multiplication sets tension, addition sets order, with hard constraints for CJK.

origin.zh: 「字号乘比率出层级、行高吸 4px 回节奏」是 Web 排版的工程惯例(调研 14§7,标注为从业者共识);中西文硬约束来自 W3C《中文排版需求》CLREQ:单面装行距不小于字号 1/2、注音场景 ≥1.5 倍基字(规范原文逐字提取);Web 混排 1.5–1.75 倍带为社区惯例,无单一权威规范(未证实,如实标注);Apple iOS 文字样式表(17/22 等)为官方实测值(调研 13§1.3)。
origin.en: 'Sizes multiply ratios for hierarchy; line-heights snap to 4px for rhythm' is web-typesetting craft convention (research 14 §7, marked as practitioner consensus); the CJK hard constraints come from W3C's CLREQ: single-side binding line spacing ≥ half the font size, ruby contexts ≥1.5× the base size (quoted verbatim from the spec); the web mixed-script 1.5–1.75× band is community practice with no single authority (unverified, stated as such); Apple's iOS text styles (17/22 etc.) are official measured values (research 13 §1.3).

effect.zh: 字号 fs(px)。默认 16 = Web 正文锚点(与 8pt 网格、48px 触控目标互质兼容的最小公倍半格来源);demo 里 17 是 Apple iOS Body 官方字号。
effect.en: Font size fs (px). Default 16 = the web body anchor (source of the least-common-multiple half-step that keeps 8pt grids and 48px touch targets compatible); 17 in the demo is Apple's official iOS Body size.

effect.zh: 行高倍率 m(无单位)。默认 1.5:16×1.5=24 恰好落 4px 网格(实跑核验);社区常见带:正文 1.5–1.75、标题 1.2–1.4(惯例,未证实为规范值);1.2 以下正文挤、2 以上段落散。
effect.en: Line-height multiplier m (unitless). Default 1.5: 16×1.5=24 lands exactly on the 4px grid (verified by running); community band: body 1.5–1.75, headings 1.2–1.4 (convention, unverified as spec values); under 1.2 body text crowds, over 2 paragraphs scatter.

effect.zh: 基线吸附单位(px)。4px 半格是 Material 4dp 基线的 Web 化——16px 字号、24px 行高、48px 触控全部兼容;8px 整格更严格但常把行高推离密度最佳值。
effect.en: Baseline snapping unit (px). The 4px half-step is Material's 4dp baseline translated to web — 16px type, 24px leading and 48px targets all compatible; the 8px step is stricter but often pushes leading off the density optimum.

note.zh: line-height 与间距吸附是纯 CSS 数学,全环境支持;行盒半Leading(leading-trim)尚未普及(提案阶段,社区口径),当前半行距分布由字体度量决定——跨字体对齐要按实测微调。
note.en: line-height and spacing snapping is pure CSS math, supported everywhere; half-leading control (leading-trim) is not yet broadly shipped (proposal stage per community sources) — half-leading distribution currently follows font metrics, so cross-font alignment needs measured tuning.

fallback.zh: 无兼容性回退可言;真正的风险是把行高吸附得太狠——15×1.5=22.5 吸附到 24 是『宁上行距』(惯例方向),但吸附到 20 就丢了呼吸感。把方向写死:round 永远向可读性侧取整。
fallback.en: There is no compatibility fallback to speak of; the real risk is snapping too hard — 15×1.5=22.5 snapped to 24 'prefers airier leading' (the conventional direction), but snapping to 20 loses the breathing room. Pin the direction: round always toward readability.

use.zh: 设计系统行高 token:字号阶 × 倍率带,全部吸附到 4px 半格
use.en: Design-system leading tokens: size scale × multiplier band, all snapped to the 4px half-step

use.zh: 中西文混排正文:守 CLREQ 下限(≥1.5×)再谈密度
use.en: Mixed CJK/Latin body text: hold the CLREQ floor (≥1.5×) before tuning density

use.zh: 卡片/列表行高定档:行高为节奏单元,内边距取其整数倍
use.en: Card/list line tiers: leading as the rhythm unit, paddings as integer multiples

use.zh: 长文排版:行高、段距、标题上下距同用一个节奏单元(vertical-rhythm 条目的数学内核)
use.en: Long-form layout: leading, paragraph gaps and heading margins share one rhythm unit (the math inside vertical-rhythm)

avoid.zh: 行高用无单位数以外的写法跨字号复用(px 行高不能继承缩放)
avoid.en: Reusing px line-heights across sizes — a px leading does not scale when inherited

avoid.zh: 标题用正文倍率(1.5+)——大字行高比率应更小(1.2–1.4),否则标题块虚胖
avoid.en: Giving headings body multipliers (1.5+) — large type wants smaller ratios (1.2–1.4) or the heading block bloats

avoid.zh: 吸附单位 ≥ 行高本身——8px 单位配 11px 字号会把小字推到爆
avoid.en: Snapping unit ≥ the leading itself — an 8px unit on 11px type explodes small text

avoid.zh: 行高低于 1.5 还开注音/拼音——CLREQ 注音场景要求 ≥1.5 倍基字,低于下限标音互相碰撞
avoid.en: Ruby/pinyin under 1.5 leading — CLREQ's ruby context requires ≥1.5× the base size; lower and the annotations collide

a11y.zh: WCAG 1.4.12 文本间距要求行高可被用户放大到字号 1.5 倍而不破版——用无单位 line-height 并给段落留吸附余量是达标前提;行高 ≥1.5 同时是低视力用户的可读下限;CJK 大字号等效条款见 contrast 条目。行高不是装饰:过密(≤1.2)显著降低读写障碍用户的阅读速度。
a11y.en: WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing requires layouts to survive user-set leading at 1.5× the font size — unitless line-height with snap headroom is the prerequisite; leading ≥1.5 doubles as the low-vision readability floor; for CJK large-text equivalence see the contrast entry. Leading is not decoration: cramped values (≤1.2) measurably slow readers with dyslexia.

goal.zh: 给一套字阶配行高:每个字号先乘密度倍率,再吸附到 4px 半格,输出 token 表并标注中西文下限检查结果。
goal.en: Pair a type scale with leadings: multiply each size by its density multiplier, snap to the 4px half-step, and emit a token table annotated with the CJK floor check.

acceptance.zh: 行高 CSS 用无单位倍数或吸附后的 px,两种口径都要给出换算
acceptance.en: Emit line-heights as unitless multipliers or snapped px — with the conversion stated either way

acceptance.zh: 吸附方向固定『宁上行距』:round(fs×m/unit)×unit,不向下牺牲可读性
acceptance.en: Snap direction fixed to 'airier': round(fs×m/unit)×unit, never downward at readability's expense

acceptance.zh: 正文行高 ≥1.5×、注音场景 ≥1.5×基字(CLREQ);标题 1.2–1.4
全部行高落 4px(或 8px)倍数,并与间距 token 同网格
acceptance.en: Every leading lands on a 4px (or 8px) multiple, sharing the grid with spacing tokens

acceptance.zh: 15×1.5=22.5 → 24 这类吸附案例逐条列出验算
acceptance.en: List snap worked examples like 15×1.5=22.5 → 24 with the arithmetic shown
